title: The cylinder (0,1) × M over a Borel countably k-rectifiable M of finite measure: Borel, rectifiable, Fubini measure identity, tangent planes ℝe₀ ⊕ T_xM
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ and Hᵈ = μHE[d]. Write ι(t,x) := (t, x_1, …, x_P) ∈ ℝ^{P+1} (Lean WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))), pr(y) := (y_1, …, y_P) ∈ ℝ^P (Lean WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.tail (WithLp.ofLp y))) and ê₀ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1. Let M ⊆ ℝ^P be Borel and countably k-rectifiable with H^k(M) < ∞. Then there is a Borel set C ⊆ ι((0,1) × M) ⊆ ℝ^{P+1} with three properties. (1) C is countably (k+1)-rectifiable. (2) H^{k+1}⌞C = ι_*(L¹⌞(0,1) ⊗ H^k⌞M), i.e. μHE[k+1].restrict C = ((volume.restrict (Ioo 0 1)).prod (μHE[k].restrict M)).map ι. (3) For H^{k+1}-a.e. y ∈ C and every linear subspace Q ⊆ ℝ^P: if M has approximate tangent space Q at pr(y) (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt k M (pr y) Q), then C has approximate tangent space span(insert ê₀ (J''Q)) = ℝê₀ ⊕ J(Q) at y, where J v := ι(0, v).
